shared_elements: tall upright stone slab/pillar carved in low relief
horizontal band or register dividing the surface
row of repeated small animal figures along the upper edge
quadruped in profile with head turned/lowered
bird-like creature in profile with long beak
zigzag / repeated linear ornament forming a band
figures silhouetted flat against a plain recessed ground
justification: Both are tall upright slabs bearing shallow, flat-topped relief in which a horizontal band of repeated linear ornament separates an upper row of small repeated animals from larger profile creatures (a quadruped and a long-beaked bird) stacked beneath, which is a fairly specific shared compositional scheme. The main differences are the clearer T-shaped, better-preserved and more legible carving of B against the more crowded, eroded and irregularly broken surface of A, whose motifs are harder to resolve and less evidently ordered into a single vertical sequence.
